_key.description: The mouse and human node handles with slashes rewritten to underscores.

_to.description: Handle of the mouse gene in the same MGI homology class.

name.description: Predicate for the human-to-mouse homology direction.

inverse_name.description: Predicate for the mouse-to-human homology direction. Identical to name; the relationship is symmetric.

relationship.description: NCI Thesaurus term for a homologous gene, as a handle into ontology_terms.

source.description: Mouse Genome Informatics, which distributes the Alliance of Genome Resources homology classes.

source_url.description: MGI report of human and mouse homology classes with sequence identifiers.

class.description: Evidence tier for the underlying data, taken from the associated files_filesets record: 'observed data' for a curated homology assertion.

method.description: How the relationship was assigned, taken from the associated files_filesets record.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file the MGI homology report was read from.

accessible_via.return: _id, name, inverse_name, relationship, source, source_url, class, method, files_filesets
